fee_notes: Royalty is a flat monthly fee (not % of sales): $550/mo (pre-2023), $595/mo (2023-2023), $695/mo (current as of 2024). Local advertising minimum is $2,000 or 10% of gross monthly revenue, whichever is greater; drops to 5% once NET EFT reaches $30,000/month. Item 6 table not fully provided in extracted text; DMA/development area transfer fee $5,000; resale/transfer fee $10,000-$19,950.
raw_excerpt: These franchise outlets paid royalties of $550, $595 or $695 per month in accordance with the franchise agreement signed for that location. Monthly royalty payments increased from $595 to $695 per month in 2024. Franchisees are required to spend a minimum of $2,000 or 10% of gross monthly revenue, whichever is greater, on local advertising.
